a: display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center centers a child.
display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr) makes three equal columns.
rem is relative to the root font size; em is relative to the parent.
box-sizing:border-box includes padding and border in the element's width.
z-index only works on positioned or flex/grid items; higher draws on top.
overflow:hidden clips content; auto adds scrollbars when needed.
position:sticky toggles between relative and fixed based on scroll.
gap sets spacing between flex or grid items without margin hacks.
Custom properties like --color: #333; are used via var(--color).
